statement: For every m prime to three, the actual rank-three norm under Y^3=X sends Phi_m(Y) exactly to Phi_m(X), with no extra sign. For each fixed integer a>=2, these norm systems give a closed embedded full product of copies of Z_3 in the global first-coordinate section fiber of H; their toric images have infinitely many independent ramified directions at pairwise distinct primes away from 3a.
where_proved: sections/E_cyclotomic_norms.tex, E.48 and formulas E48.1-E48.7; code/e_cyclotomic_norms.py, .out and .json
depends_on: E.46 exact norm-to-section map, rational radical algebras and scaled toric map
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d), actual inherited metabelian and marked quotient section maps
notes: The determinant norm of Y-xi is X-xi^3; cubing permutes primitive m-th roots exactly for 3 not dividing m.
The norm for 3-divisible indices is also proved: Phi_(m/3)(X)^2 when v3(m)=1 and Phi_(m/3)(X)^3 when v3(m)>=2.
Pairwise coprimality of Phi_ell(a^3) for distinct prime indices ell>=5 follows directly from multiplicative orders and reduction modulo a^3-1; no primitive-divisor theorem is assumed.
The infinite family uses exponents 3^(j+1) z_j. It converges at every power-class level for arbitrary product coordinates, and its toric valuation map proves injectivity and torsion-freeness.
The target is the explicit arithmetic quotient H, with the geometric kernels already recorded in E47.8.
The program passes 45 relative resultants, 108 total norms, 84 coprimality checks and exact tail bounds.
